brief:
Drop Site News reported that hospitals across Gaza face imminent power shutdowns as fuel supplies dwindle. The facilities, already strained by ongoing conflict and limited resources, risk losing electricity for critical medical equipment and life-support systems.

The report comes as a U.S. polling firm admitted to fabricating survey data, raising questions about the reliability of recently published research. In separate developments, Yemen continues to grapple with an acute water crisis affecting civilian populations across the country.
title: Gaza hospitals shut down amid power crisis
